title: Salvage Rights
summary: Marl Deeson cached a toolkit out at the Rustwater wells before raiders took the place. He wants it back — and he pays what he owes.

stages.title: Recover Marl's Toolkit
stages.description: Travel to the Rustwater wells and find Marl's cached toolkit among the raiders.

objectives.text: Find the toolkit cache at Rustwater Wells

stages.title: Return to Marl
stages.description: Bring the toolkit back to Marl Deeson in Haven Ridge.
